<style type="text/css">
    .business-banner{
  background-image: url('https://static.powtoon.co/images/banners/biz-banner-bg.svg');
background-position:center center;
  padding: .5rem 1rem;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;cursor:pointer;
  align-items: center;
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  height: 80px;
  width: 100%;
  transition: top .35s ease;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  z-index:999;
  color:#fff;
}
.banner-bg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background-image: url(https://static.powtoon.co/images/banners/business-banner-bg.svg);
    position: absolute;
    left: -200px;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1;
}
.arrows {
width: 13.3px;
height:10px;
display:inline-block;
 background-image: url(https://static.powtoon.co/images/banners/arrows-left.svg);
margin: 0 9px;
}
 .banner-btn .arrows:last-child {
   transform:rotate(180deg);
}
.business-banner-case {
   position: fixed !important;
   top: 80px !important;
}


.business-banner__txt br {
  display: none;
}





.enterprise_txt1:before {
margin-left:-20px;
}

.business-banner .enterprise_txt1{
font-family: fieldwork, sans-serif;
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.41;
    letter-spacing: 1.6px;
    color: #efef2e;
    text-transform: uppercase;
margin: 0 22px 0 0;
display:inline-block;
vertical-align: middle;
}

.business-banner .enterprise_txt2{
font-family: fieldwork, sans-serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.45;
    letter-spacing: 1.1px;
    color: #fff;
    text-transform: uppercase;
vertical-align: middle;
display:inline-block;
}


.business-banner__txt img {
    width: 65%;
    margin-top: 7px;
}

.desk{
max-width:300px;
margin-top:5px;
}

.desk img {
    width:100%;
}

.join-holiday .pow-holiday{
margin:0 15px!important;
}

.get-holiday{
background:url('https://res.cloudinary.com/powtoon-dev/image/upload/v1563952630/site/pricing-assets/bg.png') no-repeat !important;
background-position:50% 50%;
background-size:1650px;
}

.join-holiday{
  background-size:1720px;  
}

.get-holiday{
font-size:20px;
}

.join-holiday{
font-size:24px;
font-family:Muller-Thin, sans-serif;
}

.until img {
    width: 70%;
}

.until {
    margin: -1px 15px -5px -15px;
}

.t-day img {
    width: 85%;
    margin-top: 1px;
}

.join-holiday a{
    color: #19107b;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-family: Muller-Bold, sans-serif;
    margin: 0px 20px 1.5px -40px;
    padding: 10px 50px 8px;
    background-color: #4ef0fd;
    border-radius: 24px;
}

.join-holiday a:hover{
text-decoration:none;
background-color: #33883b;
}

.enterprise-banner__link:after {
  right: -20px;
  display: none;
}

.enterprise-banner__link:active,
.enterprise-banner__link:hover {
  border-bottom-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
     text-decoration: none;
}

.enterprise-banner--engage .enterprise-banner__link:active,
.enterprise-banner--engage .enterprise-banner__link:hover {
  border-bottom-color: #fff;
  color: #fff;
     text-decoration: none;
}

.enterprise-banner__link:focus,
.enterprise-banner__link:visited {
   color: #fff;
}

.enterprise-banner__close {
   cursor: pointer;
    position: absolute;
   top: 48%;
   transform: translateX(-50%);
   right: 1rem;
}

.enterprise-banner__close:after,
.enterprise-banner__close:before {
   background-color: #fff;
   content: '';
   height: 4px;
   width: 20px;
   position: absolute;
  
}

.enterprise-banner__close:after {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.enterprise-banner__close:before {
  transform: rotate(-45deg)
}


.enterprise-banner__img img {
   display: block;
}

.mob-banner-view {
    padding-top: 0 !important;
    transition: padding .35s ease;
}

.engage-logo{
margin-right:10px;
width: 206px;
}

#friday-count div{
float:left;
color:#f53124;
font: 20px/1 Muller-Bold, sans-serif;
letter-spacing: 1.6px;
}

#friday-count{
margin: 0 0 0 0;
}

#friday-count div p{
font: 10px/1 Muller-regular, sans-serif;
color:#f53124;
letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

#friday-count div span{
padding:0 10px;
}

.pinkarrow{
background: url('https://static.powtoon.co/cms-assets/pricing/squigle.png') no-repeat;
width:70px;
height:34px;
display:block;
float:right;
height:50px;
background-position:50% 50%;
}

.friday-frenzy::before, .friday-frenzy::after{
content: '';
display:block;
float:left;
background: url('https://static.powtoon.co/cms-assets/pricing/pinkarrow.png') no-repeat;
width:50px;
height:50px;
background-position:0 50% !important;
}

.friday-frenzy::after{
background: url('https://static.powtoon.co/cms-assets/pricing/squig.png') no-repeat;
float:right;
background-position:100% 50% !important;
}

.friday-frenzy{
text-transform:uppercase;
font-family: 'Anonymous Pro', monospace;
font-size: 24px;
line-height:50px;
height:50px;
text-align: center;
color: #09efd1;
}

#friday-hour p{
margin-left:-6px;
}

.iscom{
margin-right:20px;
}



a.banner-btn{
    color: #19107b;
    font-size: 18px;
cursor: pointer;
    font-family: fieldwork, sans-serif;
    margin: 2px 20px 1.5px 27px;
    padding: 0 21px;
    background-color: #4ef0fd;
    border-radius: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
display:inline-block;
height: 36px;
    line-height: 34px;
}

.enterprise-banner__txt a:hover{
color: #c805cf;
opacity:0.95;
}

.enterprise-banner__txt a .pinkarrow{
margin:-1px 5px 0 -5px;
float:left;
}

.enterprise-banner .monday-chance, .enterprise-banner .monday-chance a{
color:#fff;
}

@media only screen and (min-width: 721px) and (max-width: 1023px) {
.business-banner .enterprise_txt2 {
 font-size:18px;
}
.business-banner .enterprise_txt1{
 font-size: 27px;
}
}
@media only screen and (max-width: 720px) {
.first-section {
    padding-top: 83px !important;
}
.banner__txt {
width: 70%;
    padding-left: 2%;
}
a.banner-btn {
   width: 41%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 16px 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: initial;
    height: auto;
}
.business-banner .enterprise_txt1,.business-banner .enterprise_txt2{
display:block;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 14px;
}
.business-banner .enterprise_txt1 {
font-size: 24px;
    margin-top: -6px;
}
.business-banner{
  background-image: url('https://static.powtoon.co/images/banners/biz-banner-bg-mob.svg');
background-size: cover;
cursor: pointer;
}
.arrows {    width: 9px;
    height: 7px;
    background-size: contain;
    margin: 0 4px;
}
}
  </style>
<style type="text/css">
    .footer-socials__title {
    color: #a6a9b3;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: "muller-bold";
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.footer-logo img { width: 110px }

.footer .container .footer-socials {
   max-width: 1400px;
}

.footer-socials {
    margin: 15px 0 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
}

.footer-socials li {
   margin: 0 8px;
   list-style: none;
}

.footer-socials li img {
    opacity: 1;
    transition: opacity .35s ease;
}

.footer-socials a:hover img {
    opacity: .85
}

.copy-right {
    margin-top: 30px;
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 667px) and (min-width: 320px) {
    .footer-socials  {
         justify-content: center !important;
     }
}
  </style>

<script type="text/javascript">

  function encodeObjectToUrl(data) {
    return Object.keys(data).map(function(k) {
        return encodeURIComponent(k) + "=" + encodeURIComponent(data[k]);
    }).join('&')
  }

  //Pixel tracking
  function trackEventByPixel(category, action, opt_label, value, extra_data_obj) {
      
      
      var url="https://trek.powtoon.com/" + "event.gif";
      var data = {};
      
      data['i'] = "42wfvGNfRMLYdeKPX6mDaw";
      if (category) data['c'] = category;
      if (action) data['a'] = action;
      if (opt_label) data['l'] = opt_label;
      if (value) data['v'] = value;
      if (extra_data_obj) {
          if (extra_data_obj.powtoonId) {
              data['p'] = extra_data_obj.powtoonId;
              delete extra_data_obj.powtoonId;   // BI-team requested to avoid sending powtoonId inside extra_data
          }
          data['d'] = JSON.stringify(extra_data_obj);
      }
      if (window.powtoon_ui_session_manager) {
          var ui_session_id = window.powtoon_ui_session_manager.getSessionId();
          if (ui_session_id) data['s'] = ui_session_id;
      }
      // field for preventing cache
      data['_pc'] = Date.now();
      (new Image()).src = url + "?" + encodeObjectToUrl(data)
      
      
      return true
  }

  function trackPageViewByPixel(page) {
      
      
      var url="https://trek.powtoon.com/" + "page.gif";
      var data = {};
      
      data['i'] = "42wfvGNfRMLYdeKPX6mDaw";

      data['p'] = page || document.location.pathname

      if (window.powtoon_ui_session_manager) {
          var ui_session_id = window.powtoon_ui_session_manager.getSessionId();
          if (ui_session_id) data['s'] = ui_session_id;
      }

      if (document.referrer) data['r'] = document.referrer;
      (new Image()).src = url + "?" + encodeObjectToUrl(data)
      
      
      return true
  }

  function trackSocialEventByPixel(network, target, param) {
      
      
      var url = "https://trek.powtoon.com/" + "social.gif";
      var data = {}
      
      data['i'] = "42wfvGNfRMLYdeKPX6mDaw";
      if (network) data['n'] = network;
      if (target) data['t'] = target;
      if (param) data['p'] = param;
      // field for preventing cache
      data['_pc'] = Date.now();
      (new Image()).src = url + "?" + encodeObjectToUrl(data)
      
      
      return true
  }

  function sendGAEvent(category, action, opt_label, value) {
    if(typeof ga === "function") {
      if (value) {
        ga('send', 'event', category, action, opt_label, value);
      } else if (opt_label) {
        ga('send', 'event', category, action, opt_label);
      } else {
        ga('send', 'event', category, action);
      }
      return true;
} else {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function sendGAEventWithRetries(category, action, opt_label, value, nRetries, delay) {
    if (nRetries < 0 || delay < 0) {
        Sentry.captureException(new Error('sendGAEventWithRetries function was called with illegal params - nRetries=' + nRetries + ', delay=' + delay));
    }

    // Try to report event...
    const result = sendGAEvent(category, action, opt_label, value);

    if (!result) {
      // reporting failed
      if (nRetries > 0) {
        setTimeout(function() {
          sendGAEventWithRetries(category, action, opt_label, value, nRetries-1, delay);
        }, delay);
      } else {
        Sentry.captureException(new Error('GA function is not loaded properly (after retries)'));
      }
    }
  }

  // Google analytics
  function trackEventByParams(category, action, opt_label, value, extra_data_obj) {
    // Track event by 4 params used only for google analytics
    
      sendGAEventWithRetries(category, action, opt_label, value, 2, 1000);
      trackEventByPixel(category, action, opt_label, value, extra_data_obj);
    
  }

  // wrapper function for backward compatibility
  function trackEventByParamsOnlyGA(category, action, opt_label, value) {
    
    return trackEventByParams(category, action, opt_label, value);
    
  }

  // track pageviews
  function trackPageView(page) {
    
      if (typeof ga === "undefined") {
          Sentry.captureException(
                  new Error('GA function is not loaded properly')
          );
          return;
      }

      if (page)
          ga('send', 'pageview', page);
      else
          ga('send', 'pageview');

      trackPageViewByPixel(page);
    
  }

  function trackSocialEvent(network, target, param) {
    
    if(typeof ga === "undefined")
      return

    if (param)
      ga('social', network, target, param)
    else
      ga('social', network, target)
    trackSocialEventByPixel(network, target, param)
    
  }

  function trackEvent(data) {
    // this function used to track to woopra,
    // i leave it only to prevent JS error should a reference to it be missed,
    // from CMS for example
  }

  function trackSocial(social_network){
    // this function used to track to woopra,
    // i leave it only to prevent JS error should a reference to it be missed,
    // from CMS for example
  }

</script>

function toggle_maintenance(maintenance, customHTML, iframeUrl) {
    if ($('.maintenance')[0]) {
        $('.maintenance').slideToggle();
        return
    }
    var html = "";

    if (customHTML) {
        html = customHTML;
    }
    if (maintenance) {
        html = '<div  style="width:1000px;margin:90px auto 0"><span><iframe src="/strip/website/" frameborder="0" border="0" width="870" height="60"></iframe></span><span style="color: #848484;background: transparent;width: 30px;margin-top: 17px;cursor: pointer;" class="close" onclick="$(\'.maintenance\').slideToggle()">X</span></div>';
    }
    if (iframeUrl) {
        html = '<div  style="width:1000px;margin:90px auto 0"><span><iframe src="/notifications/' + iframeUrl + '/" frameborder="0" border="0" width="960" height="140"></iframe></span><span style="color: #848484;background: transparent;width: 30px;margin-top: 11px;cursor: pointer;" class="close" onclick="$(\'.maintenance\').slideToggle();">X</span></div>';
    }
    var cont = '<div style="display:none; text-align:center;" class="maintenance">' + html + '</div>';

    $('body').prepend(cont);
    $('.maintenance').slideToggle();

};

//popup function

    function pop_container(html,track_name){
        trackEventByParams('Show Placeholder', 'Click', track_name);
        //this is redondent because function is async

        $('#popup-container')
                .append($(html))
                .css('z-index', '100000000000');

        $('#popup-container style').appendTo( $('head') );

        var popupImg = $('#popup-container img');
        var imgSrc = popupImg.attr('src');
        if(imgSrc.indexOf('maintenance') !== -1)
        {
            popupImg.parent().addClass('maintenance_popup');
        }

        // handle the popup view
        $('#popup-container').show();
        $('.overlay').show();
        $('.editor-overlay').show();


        $('.close, .overlay, .pt-close').bind('click',function(){
            $('#popup-container').hide();
            $('.overlay').hide();
            $('.editor-overlay').hide();
        });
    }


    function show_placeholder(placeholder_url,template){
        //prevent multi-calls, this flag might be set from external JS code (CMS for example)
        if(placeholder_viewed)
            return false;
        var html;
        template = template || false; //default = false
        placeholder_url = placeholder_url || false;

        if(template){
            html = template;
            placeholder_url = 'errors';
        }

        else if( placeholder_url.indexOf("image@") > -1){ //images should be 800 px to be centered
            var src = placeholder_url.substring(6);
            html ='<span class="close" style="width: 0px;height: 14px;background: transparent;position: absolute;right: 31px;top: 18px;">X</span><img src=' + placeholder_url.substring(6) + ' />';
        }

        else{
            $.get(placeholder_url, function(data) {
                html = data;
                pop_container(html,placeholder_url);

             });
             return;
         }

        pop_container(html,placeholder_url);

    }

$(function(){
  var setCSRFHeader = function (xhr, settings) {
    function getCookie(name) {
      var cookieValue = null;
      if (document.cookie && document.cookie != '') {
        var cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
          var cookie = jQuery.trim(cookies[i]);
          // Does this cookie string begin with the name we want?
          if (cookie.substring(0, name.length + 1) == (name + '=')) {
            cookieValue = decodeURIComponent(cookie.substring(name.length + 1));
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      return cookieValue;
    }

    if (!(/^http:.*/.test(settings.url) || /^https:.*/.test(settings.url))) {
      // Only send the token to relative URLs i.e. locally.
      xhr.setRequestHeader("X-CSRFToken", getCookie('csrftoken'));
    }
  };
  $.ajaxSetup({
    beforeSend: setCSRFHeader
  });
});
